name_reason: Already compliant: data_fd2_ prefix, ui_menu domain, saved_cursor_idx descriptor that accurately reflects role (persisted/saved cursor index, a state var). No Ghidra address residue. The numeric content is a runtime cursor index, not a domain ID list.
purpose: Persisted shop-menu cursor index: saved companion of the live cursor data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx (0x53C57), so the shop grid highlight survives across the open/select/close dialog round trips.
logic_summary: fd2_run_buy_item_menu copies it into the live cursor (0x53C57) before each panel re-open and snapshots the live cursor back into it after the input loop (restore at 0x2F1B0: MOV EAX,[0x5414B]; MOV [0x53C57],EAX ; save at 0x2F1E9: MOV [0x5414B],EAX). The saved index is then reused as a base address added to the shop item-id array (param_2) to fetch the chosen item id, e.g. 0x2F206: MOV EAX,[0x5414B]; MOVZX EBX,byte ptr [EAX+EBP*1] (also at 0x2F112/0x2F317/0x2F3E8). fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main resets it to 0 on menu entry (0x2E4A1: MOV dword ptr [0x5414B],0x0).
datatype: uint32 (dword, 4 bytes); accessed as a full dword in every reference, never a byte/word slice.
element_semantics: Scalar state variable holding the menu cursor index (0-based selection offset). Treated as an unsigned offset into the shop item-id byte array at the reader sites.
notes: BSS zero-init scalar (memory all zero at 0x5414B). Two game-side WRITE xrefs (0x2E4A1 reset, 0x2F1E9 save) -> mutable, not const. Both the existing src comment block (chintro.c lines 818-833) and the Ghidra PLATE_COMMENT are already accurate, precise, and mutually consistent (same pairing with saved_scroll_offset @0x5414F, same writers/readers, same save/restore pattern); verified against the disassembly of fd2_run_buy_item_menu (restore/save at 0x2F1B0/0x2F1E9, reads at 0x2F112/0x2F206/0x2F317/0x2F3E8) and the reset in fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main (0x2E4A1). No src edit and no plate edit needed.
